promise: "We will legalize, regulate and restrict access to marijuana."
description: Campaign pledge to legalize recreational cannabis. The Cannabis Act received royal assent in June 2018 and legalization took effect October 17, 2018, roughly on the timeline promised.
evidence: Task force on cannabis legalization reported Dec 2016, government followed its recommendations

promise: Provide a special report in 2018 on the impacts of global warming of 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels (Paris decision 1/CP.21).
description: The Paris decision (Dec 2015) invited the IPCC to deliver SR1.5 'in 2018'. The report was approved at IPCC-48 (Incheon) and published on 8 October 2018, exactly on schedule, and became the scientific anchor of the 'keep 1.5 alive' movement.
evidence: SR1.5 published 8 October 2018, within the requested 2018 timeframe
Found 1.5°C requires 45% CO2 cuts by 2030 and net zero by ~2050 - figures that shaped NDCs and net-zero pledges
